en.title: Spain lost 540 km² of snow cover in a week: where it still holds
en.description: Spain lost 540 km² of snow cover in a week: where it still holds. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Spain on 16 November.
en.lede: Seven days ago about 850 km² was white in Spain; today it is 310 km², 540 km² less.

p: The losses are at the bottom of the slopes. Higher up the snow is settling rather than going, so the upper lifts are the safe bet.
Snow covers roughly 310 km² in Spain on 16 November, 440 km² lost since yesterday.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: No height band is mostly white yet. Mild days have cost 540 km² since the 850 km² of a week ago.
Snow depth on the ground, height by height: 2,000-2,500 m: on average under 1 cm (4 % of the ground white); above 2,500 m: on average 3 cm (33 % white).
The deepest snow of the country's resorts is at Aramón Cerler: 17 cm.
Next on the list: Candanchu (14 cm), Formigal (11 cm), Boí Taüll (5 cm) and Estació d'Esquí Baqueira-Beret (3 cm).
Aramón Cerler picked up 13 cm in the last three days and could add 9 cm by Thursday 19 November.
At Candanchu: 28 cm of fresh snow over three days, 7 cm more expected by Thursday 19 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 6 out of 31 resorts in Spain.

The rest of the shortlist: Formigal: 11 cm on top, 24 cm in three days, 6 cm expected; Boí Taüll: 5 cm on top, 11 cm in three days, 7 cm expected; Estació d'Esquí Baqueira-Beret: 3 cm on top, 5 cm in three days, 6 cm expected.
The week ahead could bring up to 4 cm, 2 cm of it in the next three days.
The snowiest day looks like Thursday 19 November, with up to 4 cm in the snowiest spots.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 32 cm on the snowiest slopes.
Mild weather is eating into the cover: expect firm snow in the morning and slush in the afternoon.

sections.h: New snow in the last three days
p: Hardly any new snow fell in the last three days: the three-day maximum is 0 cm.

Here is how the deepest resorts compare with their usual 16 November: Aramón Cerler: 0 cm at about 2,060 m, against 2 cm in a normal year; Candanchu: 0 cm at about 1,876 m, against 3 cm in a normal year; Formigal: 0 cm at about 1,883 m, against 4 cm in a normal year; Boí Taüll: 0 cm at about 2,393 m, against 4 cm in a normal year.
0 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Aramón Cerler usually came early February / mid-February.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Andorra: 2 % white, deepest Pal-Arinsal with 5 cm, up to 7 cm in the week ahead; France: 11 % white, deepest Les Arcs with 94 cm, up to 105 cm in the week ahead.

advice: Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Read the local avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.

es.title: ¿Cuánta nieve hay en España? Manto de nieve y previsión, 16 de noviembre de 2026
es.description: Nieve en España el 16 de noviembre: manto de nieve, nieve nueva, espesor por altitud, próximos días y mejores estaciones.
es.lede: Lunes, 16 de noviembre: la nieve cubre unos 310 km² de montaña en España. Son 440 km² menos que ayer.

p: Ninguna franja de altitud está aún mayoritariamente blanca. Hace siete días la superficie era de 850 km², 540 km² más que ahora.

sections.h: Espesor de la nieve por altitud
p: El espesor de la nieve depende de la altitud: 2000–2500 m: de media menos de 1 cm (4 % cubierto); por encima de 2500 m: de media 3 cm (33 % cubierto).
En los últimos tres días apenas ha nevado: el máximo es de 0 cm.
El tiempo templado se come el manto: nieve dura por la mañana, nieve húmeda por la tarde.
En los próximos tres días se esperan hasta 2 cm, y en toda la semana hasta 4 cm.
El día más nevado: jueves, 19 de noviembre, con hasta 4 cm.
En cabeza está Aramón Cerler: 17 cm en la parte alta de las pistas.
Le siguen: Candanchu (14 cm), Formigal (11 cm), Boí Taüll (5 cm) y Estació d'Esquí Baqueira-Beret (3 cm).
Aramón Cerler: 13 cm de nieve nueva en tres días y hasta 9 cm más antes del jueves, 19 de noviembre.

advice: Por encima del bosque la nieve puede estar venteada: cuidado en las crestas.
